title: University ownership as a moderator effect: the impact of human security of academic staff on job retention
core_idea: Investigate the effect of academic staff human security (job, legal, economic, research, personal/moral aspects) on job retention at Jordanian universities and examine whether university ownership (public vs private) moderates that relationship, using a cross-sectional online survey (n=356) and structural equation modeling.
tldr: Examines whether dimensions of human security for academic staff predict job retention and if university ownership moderates this relationship in Jordanian universities using survey data and SEM.
